# Waerebo Lodge

> Official website of Waerebo Lodge, a lodge and travel basecamp in Dintor, Flores, Indonesia, for journeys to Wae Rebo Village and destinations across Manggarai.

Waerebo Lodge provides accommodation, guided trekking packages, a restaurant, and transport services. The website is available in English and Indonesian. Use the canonical `https://waerebo-lodge.com` URLs below.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://waerebo-lodge.com/): Overview of Waerebo Lodge, its location, services, guest experiences, and contact details.
- [About Waerebo Lodge](https://waerebo-lodge.com/about): The lodge's story, purpose, community commitment, and history.
- [Lodge and Rooms](https://waerebo-lodge.com/lodge): Available room types, facilities, and links to room details.
- [Wae Rebo Trips](https://waerebo-lodge.com/trips): Guided trekking packages and custom itineraries.
- [Restaurant](https://waerebo-lodge.com/restaurant): Dining information and daily menu highlights.
- [Transport](https://waerebo-lodge.com/transport): Airport transfers, lodge transfers, and transport options across Flores.
- [Destinations](https://waerebo-lodge.com/destination/waerebo-village): Wae Rebo Village and nearby Flores destinations.
- [Gallery](https://waerebo-lodge.com/gallery): Photographs and guest moments from the lodge and surrounding destinations.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://waerebo-lodge.com/faq): Answers about stays, trips, transport, dining, and booking.
